name: TV/TVC Runtime Boundary Observation
purpose: Observe or derive an existing TV/TVC-authorized provider-operation runtime from qualifying real provider-operation receipt chains, using the existing non-secret synthetic observer only as a diagnostic fallback, then admit the exact evidence through Interlock/InTr and carry it to Master Records custody without creating runtime, transition, credential, or custody authority.
trigger: a canonical task requires TVC runtime/broker evidence and a qualifying real provider-operation receipt chain exists or diagnostic route posture must be checked
scope: one manifest-bound TVC runtime evidence trajectory using existing provider-operation receipts first and synthetic observation only when needed for diagnostics
reuse_instructions: Use the local scripts/run_tvc_runtime_boundary_reusable.py wrapper so the generic trigger remains inside its admitted scripts/*.py surface. The wrapper resolves only already-local StegVerse-Labs/TVC source, executes the canonical TVC primary-runtime preflight and same-service activation tasks, then runs the non-secret TVC observer. It performs no source fetch, exports no protected value, and emits no standardized completion result; the generic lifecycle therefore stops at evidence reconciliation unless separately admissible evidence satisfies the declared predicates. A qualifying real provider-operation round-trip remains preferred READY evidence; the synthetic observer cannot alone prove an authentic provider session. Interlock/InTr admits evidence and Master Records owns observed-reality/provenance custody and reconstruction.
